bibl.title: Thomas William Allen-Girolamo Vitelli (carteggio 1889-1896)
bibl.seg: Anna Di Giglio, Thomas William Allen - Girolamo Vitelli (carteggio 1889-1896).
bibl.note: Five letters written by Thomas Williams Allen to Girolamo Vitelli, between 1889 and 1896, are preserved in the Laurentian Library. The two scholars discuss about manuscripts of the Iliad, Homeric Hymns and Batracomiomachia.
